# Andrea Burchiani — burghi.design

> Personal portfolio of Andrea Burchiani, an Italian graphic and communication designer based between Milano and Ancona. The site collects editorial, UX/UI and digital projects produced between 2023 and 2025, mostly during the Bachelor's and Master's program in Communication Design at Politecnico di Milano, and current work at Maize.io.

## About

- Name: Andrea Burchiani
- Born: 12 October 2000
- Location: Milano ↔ Ancona, Italy
- Education: Bachelor's + Master's degree, Politecnico di Milano (Communication Design)
- Currently: Designer at Maize.io
- Email: andreaburchiani00@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/andreaburchiani.bip/
- CV: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DIEHX7AeN_mUJnqSpUiJHyiFh9mIZLk8/view

## Projects

### Editorial

- [Patina (2024)](https://burghi.design/projects/patina.html): Editorial project / wunderkammer about collecting. Issue N°3 focuses on collecting sounds. Group project at Politecnico di Milano. Skills: creative direction, curatorship, layout design.
- [Częstochowa (2025)](https://burghi.design/projects/czesto.html): Editorial project on the Polish city of Częstochowa.
- [Policatto (2024)](https://burghi.design/projects/policatto.html): Editorial project.
- [Referto (2024)](https://burghi.design/projects/referto.html): Editorial project.
- [Spacca (2024)](https://burghi.design/projects/spacca.html): Editorial project.
- [Tesi (2025)](https://burghi.design/projects/tesi.html): Master's thesis editorial project.
- [W-Hysteria (2024)](https://burghi.design/projects/w-hysteria.html): Editorial project.

### UX / UI

- [Bottleneck (2024)](https://burghi.design/projects/bottleneck.html): UX/UI project on a notification-management system that filters and prioritises desktop and mobile alerts.
- [TBD (2023)](https://burghi.design/projects/tbd.html): UX/UI project.

### Other

- [Tripup](https://burghi.design/projects/tripup.html): Travel-related project.
